`madeira-land.geojson` contains 30 unchanged full-resolution level-1 polygon
rings from GSHHG 2.3.7 (`gshhs_f.b`), selected by western longitude between
340° and 345° and southern latitude between 30° and 35°. Longitudes are
converted to the -180°…180° range; polygon IDs are retained. No simplification,
buffer, harbour exemption or land-crossing tolerance is applied.

Source: https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/pwessel/gshhg/gshhg-bin-2.3.7.zip
(SHA-256: `28600e8f7a08645aab43079326df6504212ec5ccb2b4bcf3b5f4f12ed60e82bc`).
Data documentation: https://www.ngdc.noaa.gov/mgg/shorelines/shorelines.html
and https://www.soest.hawaii.edu/pwessel/gshhg/.

Credit: Paul Wessel and Walter H. F. Smith, University of Hawaii and NOAA.
This coastline fixture is separately licensed LGPL-3.0-or-later; see the
original `GSHHG-LICENSE.txt`, `COPYING.LESSERv3` and `COPYINGv3` alongside it.
The remainder of the repository retains its existing license. Regeneration
instructions are in `evidence/madeira/README.md`.
